description: Test file for the Parser class handling ProtoLog trace files, verifying timestamp extraction and log message reconstruction.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Represents a parsed log message with text, timestamp, tag, level, and source location.

classes.name: Timestamp
classes.description: Represents a timestamp with a specific type (ELAPSED or REAL) and value.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type, expected to be PROTO_LOG.

methods.name: getLengthEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of log entries in the trace.

methods.name: getTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves an array of timestamps of a specified type (ELAPSED or REAL).

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Reconstructs a human-readable log message for a given entry index and timestamp type.
